Now I can see the issue clearly:

1. Both failed jobs ran past the `activeDeadlineSeconds` of 3600 seconds (1 hour) and were killed with SIGTERM (exit code 143).

2. Looking at the batch timing:
   - For the May 20 run: It started at 01:00 and by 01:51 had finished 60/95 batches. It was killed at 02:00 (exactly 1 hour after start) at batch 69/95. The data volume is 9.4M rows vs the previously successful run which must have been smaller.
   - The May 19 run shows the same pattern, killed at the one-hour mark around batch 71/93 out of a growing dataset. The SMTP errors in the logs are unrelated noise from notification emails, not the actual cause. The real problem is that the export data volume has outgrown what can be processed within the fixed 1-hour deadline.

The fix is to bump up `activeDeadlineSeconds` in the CronJob spec to give the job more room to finish. Let me look for documentation on that setting so I can reference it properly.
